task.description:
REWORK 1: Fix test isolation violations in Stage F4 E2E tests.

Critical issue (BLOCKER): Tests share fixtures via beforeAll() instead of creating per-test instances. This violates test isolation and makes tests order-dependent.

Issues to fix:
- [BLOCKER] TK-UI-04-E2E-02 and E2E-04 both complete same task from simpleInstance - need separate per-test instances
- [BLOCKER] TK-UI-05-E2E-03 claims group task that other tests depend on - need per-test instances
- [BLOCKER] All beforeAll() fixtures must be moved to beforeEach() for true per-test isolation
- [MAJOR] TK-UI-01 test spec defines 7 cases but only 3 implemented - implement all 7
- [MAJOR] Complete missing test cases for filter combinations

Fix by:
1. Refactor web/tests/e2e/f4-task-inbox.e2e.spec.ts to create new definition/instance/task for each test
2. Use test.beforeEach() to set up per-test fixtures
3. Ensure each test cleans up after itself with defer statements
4. Update test specs to match implemented test count
5. Run tests locally to verify no order-dependency
acceptance_criteria: Each test creates its own definition, instance, and task fixtures
beforeEach() used for per-test setup, not beforeAll()
Tests pass in any execution order (no shared state)
No test failures due to order-dependency
All changes committed to feature branch
